name: biceps leg concentration curl
description: A seated curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh. Isolates the biceps and cuts out swinging.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your feet wide.
Brace one elbow against the inside of the same thigh and grip the opposite leg just above the ankle.
Curl your hand toward your shoulder, lifting that leg while it pushes down to resist.
Lower the leg slowly to the floor.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
